title: Arthur Young's Reflexive Universe: spirit descends into matter and returns

tellings.quote: the process the whole universal process is one of spirit descending into matter and then matter ascending back into the realm of spirit.

plain: A researcher of the mind and the paranormal, Jeffrey Mishlove, describes the ideas of Arthur Young, an inventor and thinker who wrote a 1976 book called The Reflexive Universe. As Mishlove tells it, Young saw the whole universe as one process in which spirit comes down into physical matter and then matter rises back up into spirit. If right, it would mean that mind and spirit, not matter, sit at the root of everything.
